description: This header file declares functions, structs, and method signatures related to tensor operations and expression handling within the Torch JIT Tensorexpr namespace. It includes tensor info retrieval, shape broadcasting, type promotion, and tensor computing functions such as chunk, transpose, expand, reshape, flatten, concatenation, and embedding.

classes.name: TensorInfo
classes.description: A struct holding tensor dimensions and data type information.

methods.name: getTensorInfo
methods.description: Retrieve tensor information such as shape and dtype from a buffer handle.

methods.name: normalizeAndCheckIndex
methods.description: Adjust and validate an index given a tensor dimension size.

methods.name: boolToInteger
methods.description: Convert a boolean expression handle to an integer expression handle.

methods.name: promoteToDtype
methods.description: Promote an expression handle to a specified scalar type.

methods.name: promoteInputs
methods.description: Apply type promotion rules to a list of expression handles.

methods.name: promoteIntegerToDefaultType
methods.description: Convert an integer expression handle to the default scalar type.

methods.name: promoteHalfToFloat
methods.description: Promote a half-precision float expression handle to float.

methods.name: demoteOutput
methods.description: Demote an expression handle to a specified optional scalar type.

methods.name: broadcastShapes
methods.description: Compute broadcasted shape(s) from shape tensors.

methods.name: valueShape
methods.description: Get shape information from an ArgValue.

methods.name: tensorOrConstant
methods.description: Generate an expression handle representing either a tensor or a constant value.

methods.name: scalarOrConstant
methods.description: Generate an expression handle representing a scalar or a constant value.

methods.name: broadcast
methods.description: Broadcast a buffer handle to a specified shape.

methods.name: constant
methods.description: Create a constant expression handle from an ArgValue.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamp an input expression handle within min and max bounds.

methods.name: computeChunk
methods.description: Compute a chunked tensor operation.

methods.name: computeTranspose
methods.description: Compute the transpose of a tensor.

methods.name: computeExpand
methods.description: Expand a tensor to a new shape.

methods.name: computeReshape
methods.description: Reshape a tensor.

methods.name: computeFlatten
methods.description: Flatten a tensor.

methods.name: computeCatWoConditionals
methods.description: Concatenate tensors without conditionals.

methods.name: computeCat
methods.description: Concatenate tensors with output shape and strides.

methods.name: computeEmbedding
methods.description: Compute embedding lookup.
